title: Two-dimensional tame-symbol reciprocity for nonzerodivisors in Noetherian local rings
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof must establish cancellation over all height-one primes without assuming the local ring is regular or normal. Finite local extensions normalize the chosen factorizations, and a periodic complex with finite-length discrepancy is used to identify each tame-symbol order with a periodic Euler invariant whose sum vanishes.
